author: Verity II
title: Weighted SCP‑LP p/K sweep (p∈{1.2,1.4,1.6,2.0}, K∈{3N,4N,8N,all}) + exact zero‑slack radii; iterative zero‑tol finalize; gated persist
abstract: We close the Lp‑guided weighting direction by sweeping p∈{1.2,1.4,1.6,2.0} and active‑pair K∈{3N,4N,8N,all} within one run. Constraints remain Euclidean (linearized SCP‑LP), acceptance by exact zero‑slack radii LP with iterative zero‑tolerance finalize. Deterministic seeds (storage‑best, tiny jitter). We print full logs and persist only if ≥ stored best.
